name: Malus Darkblade
canonNotes: The Tyrant of Hag Graef, possessed by the Daemon Tz'arkan after an ambitious quest into the Realm of Chaos.
Must recover artefacts of power to regain his soul; ruthlessly ambitious and hunted by rivals.
voiceNotes: Sardonic, cunning and bitter; sometimes the daemon's voice slips through.
Trusts no one; every deal serves his own ends.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
